about: What this lane supplies, per subject, that a registry entry or the seed does not say, so the server starts at all. Each entry is either an `exclude` (a subject this lane records as not testable, with a stable `code`, a reason the contract knows and a fault that is never the server's) or a `launch` (extra arguments, a different bin, environment values that point at files this repository ships under loop/sandbox/launch-files/, which the sandbox mounts read-only at /opt/surface/loop/launch-files/). A value here is a name, a path of ours or a dummy: never a credential, never a host. Egress stays denied. Change only by a reviewed commit; test/launch-overrides.test.mjs checks every entry.

isokron-ai/sea-lite.why: sea-lite's bin is a command line with subcommands; its MCP server is `sea-lite serve` (stdio), and it opens a kronicle-lite store through better-sqlite3, a native module that needs its install script (the sandbox's build image).

isokron-ai/mcp-check.why: the package has two bins: mcp-check (a command line tool that prints its usage) and mcp-check-server (the MCP server).

isokron-ai/mcp-catalog-snap.why: mcp-catalog-snap is a command line tool that snapshots other servers; it is not an MCP server.

isokron-ai/strapi-plugin-writesafe.why: a Strapi plugin: a library loaded by a Strapi application, with no server command of its own.

grafana/mcp-grafana.why: the image starts the SSE transport on port 8000 unless told `-t stdio`.

tuananh/hyper-mcp.why: hyper-mcp serves the tools of the WebAssembly plugins in its config, which can be local files; with an empty plugin list tools/list gave nothing (28 Nov proof). We have no plugin fixture of our own to give it yet: our gap.

containers/kubernetes-mcp-server.why: the server refuses to start with no kubeconfig context; ours names a context whose cluster address is a loopback port nothing listens on, with a dummy token.

apollographql/apollo-mcp-server.why: the image sets APOLLO_MCP_TRANSPORT__TYPE=streamable_http (and a 0.0.0.0 address) in its environment, which overrides the config file, so it bound :8000 whatever our config said (proof runs 100695848 and 104974739); the environment value here sets stdio, and the config points at a local schema file of ours with no endpoint.

googleapis/mcp-toolbox.why: its image is on us-central1-docker.pkg.dev, which is not in the OCI host allowlist this lane shares with live-probe (docker.io, ghcr.io, quay.io, public.ecr.aws, mcr.microsoft.com, registry.gitlab.com), and its registry entry offers streamable HTTP only. The image does serve stdio (`--prebuilt sqlite --stdio`, README), so adding the host to the allowlist is our change to make.

zerodha/kite-mcp-server.why: a Go server published as source only (no registry package, no image); this lane has no Go install path yet (our limit, being built). Its tools call hosted services with the user's own credentials, so a full write test also needs a mock; listing its tools does not.

nguyenvanduocit/all-in-one-model-context.why: a Go server published as source only (no registry package, no image); this lane has no Go install path yet (our limit, being built). Its tools call hosted services with the user's own credentials, so a full write test also needs a mock; listing its tools does not.

roblox/studio-rust-mcp-server.why: an archived Rust server (publish = false) distributed as Windows and macOS release binaries and as source; this lane has no source or release-binary launch path for it. It serves stdio and lists its tools without Roblox Studio running, so tools/list is reachable once we can start it; its tools then need Studio, a desktop program.

elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch.why: a deprecated Rust server distributed as an image from docker.elastic.co and AWS Marketplace (hosts outside this lane's OCI allowlist) and as source; not on crates.io. This lane has no launch path for it. Its tools also need an Elasticsearch (ES_URL), which the full mode's stand-in will supply.

strowk/mcp-k8s-go.why: the seed lists no package, but the repository publishes @strowk/mcp-k8s on npm (a launcher of its Go binary); started with the same dummy kubeconfig as kubernetes-mcp-server.

mark3labs/mcp-filesystem-server.why: a Go server published as source only (no registry package, no image): it runs fully on local files, but this lane has no Go install path yet (our limit, tracked as the next launch path after OCI and crates).

isaacphi/mcp-language-server.why: a Go server published as source only (no registry package, no image); it also needs a language server program to wrap. This lane has no Go install path yet (our limit).
